summary.text: Blood Light Spirit Suppression is Feng Jun's recently created immortal killer move. He intends it to suppress Hei Fan grotto-heaven's heavenly spirit, and all three sworn siblings must activate it together.

claims.text: In a cave on Wang Gu Mountain, Feng Jun tells Zheng Tuo and Zhou Min that without taking risks they cannot break free of this cage. Zheng Tuo answers that it is a huge matter and that carelessness means death. Feng Jun cultivates luck path and has had an ominous feeling that if they do not take the chance now, they might not have a chance anymore. Zhou Min notes that Feng Jun went up Immortal Succession Mountain and cultivated the luck path inheritance there. As the first inheritor, even though his cultivation did not reach rank seven, his dao marks are not less than those of a rank seven luck path Gu Immortal. She has heard that with a certain number of luck path dao marks, the Gu Immortal will have a mystical promotion. Zheng Tuo adds that luck path Gu Immortals would have some sensation towards their own luck or the luck around them.

When the bell rings ten times, Feng Jun reads the stone tablet rule: the person from the main tribe who is qualified to inherit Hei Fan’s true inheritance has arrived, and he takes that as the source of his bad feeling. Zhou Min says the result is not out of control yet. Feng Jun says they still have a chance and they go immediately, determined not to expose any flaws.

After Fang Yuan arrives as the proper inheritor, Feng Jun says they have practised the move and are at the crucial moment. In a few days they expect to suppress the heavenly spirit and take the true inheritance by force.

Soul searching Zheng Tuo, Zhou Min, and Feng Jun, Fang Yuan learns their scheme and is glad he struck quickly. He finds Feng Jun’s sudden creation of the move quite suspicious and assumes it was likely heaven’s will’s influence.

After killing Wu Yi Hai, Fang Yuan waits for blood asset Immortal Gu to recover and works to modify this immortal killer move. He obtains a simplified version that uses blood asset Immortal Gu as the core. Using the upper extreme heavenly eagle, he enters Wu Yi Hai’s blessed land, gets close to the land spirit, and suppresses it with the move, then annexes the blessed land.
In Eastern Sea he uses the move to suppress You Chan’s land spirit and annex that water path immortal aperture, then uses it again to subdue Qin Bai He’s land spirit.
Against Qi Sea heavenly spirit, the move cannot work on a rank eight level heavenly spirit. Fang Yuan kills that heavenly spirit instead.
